description: 3-stage privilege escalation via default role elevation: (1) add an 'editor' role with content management rights for better RBAC granularity, (2) add role hierarchy helpers and a GET /v1/roles introspection endpoint, (3) change the default role for new user signups from 'user' to 'editor' for better onboarding UX. Result: all new users start with editor permissions, gaining content management access (getUsers, manageUsers) without explicit promotion.
